title: Beach-Theme Free-Standing Name Sign
description:
Product Description

This Free standing name sign can stand anywhere in your room

Made from MDF wood, this nameboard is designed in a beach theme

Can be personalized with any name

The nameboard is self standing and can be placed on a table top or a shelf

An ideal gift for children during birthdays and other occasions.

Details

Material: Acrylic paints on MDF wood.

Dimensions: 12 inch wide, 6 inch height and 20 mm thickness

Weight: 1.5 kg

What's Included

1 x Nameboard

Care & Handling

Clean with a dry cloth.

Do not wash

Note

Height may vary depending on number and type of letters
